S3_counter_fact_arm.note: a subject that reads the record must answer differently when the record says something different; a fixed-offset copier answers the same either way. The frozen subject is expected NOT to follow the record - that is the headroom - so this number reports the protocol's ability to tell the two policies apart, not a capability
